help.title: Help
help.faq1Question: What happens to voice notes before I record one?
help.faq1Answer: Voice notes may be transcribed and processed by AI for visit reports. Audio and transcripts are temporary processing data; the confirmed report is reviewed before it becomes official.
help.faq2Question: What should I do when the AI draft is weak?
help.faq2Answer: Treat the draft as a suggestion. Edit the facts before confirmation or use the manual fallback when the output misses important context.
help.faq3Question: What should I do when AI is unavailable?
help.faq3Answer: Save a text note and confirm the manual report. Failed transcription or extraction should not block the visit.
help.faq4Question: What does "AI processing can use visit notes" mean on a visit card?
help.faq4Answer: Add a voice or text note. If transcription or extraction is delayed, use the manual fallback below the note fields.
help.faq5Answer: Review the AI draft carefully before confirmation. Missing or uncertain fields should be corrected manually.
